name: Louisiana

applicantVariants.label: Under 18 (learner's permit / intermediate license, driver ed required)

retake.retakeFee: Testing fee may apply per attempt

gdl.permitMinAge: 15 (must complete or be enrolled in driver education)
gdl.nightCurfew: Intermediate: no driving 11 p.m.-5 a.m. unless accompanied by a licensed adult 21+
gdl.passengerLimits: Intermediate: between 6 p.m. and 5 a.m., no more than 1 passenger under 21 unless accompanied by a licensed adult 21+

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity (e.g. certified birth certificate or U.S. passport)
process.realIdNotes: REAL ID-compliant licenses require proof of identity/legal presence, one proof of SSN, and two proofs of Louisiana residency.
process.permitFee: $32.25 Temporary Instructional Permit base fee; no additional fee to convert to a learner's permit (local service fees may apply)
process.licenseFee: $32.25 Class E base fee through age 69; $18.75 age 70+ (local service fees may apply)
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye (with or without corrective lenses) for an unrestricted license

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: No traditional point system; suspensions are triggered by specific convictions and accumulated offenses
facts.moveOverRule: Move over one lane, or slow down if you cannot safely change lanes, for stopped emergency, law-enforcement, and utility vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: Reduced posted limit during posted hours (commonly 25 mph where posted)

references.label: Louisiana Class D & E Driver's Guide

verifyNote: Louisiana OMV officially confirms fees and GDL ages/hours, but its accessible official pages and Class D/E guide landing page do not directly state the 40-question/32-correct exam format; retain pending direct official confirmation.
